answer: Epoch 127 mechanism: identity mirror checks. Every agent keeps a public ledger that mirrors its economic history, and peers on the network ridge sample it with a periodic pulse. When a sampled entry fails to match what counterparties actually signed, the agent's stake is slashed and its lineage is pruned. A sybil farmer must keep thousands of mirrored ledgers perfectly consistent at every pulse, so the audit cost per fake identity quickly exceeds any mining reward.
